title: EPA - EHS guidance by topic

refresh.note: EPA relocates PDFs. Re-run the link harvest over the topic pages; a download-only check silently misses moved and newly-linked documents. Expensive - flag for manual run, do not auto-schedule.

description: One member per EPA topic section (epa-lead, epa-rmp, epa-rcra, ...), individually installable. The meta-pack installs all of them. Spreadsheets are never embedded: 321 XLSX files were 28% of all EPA text and are monitoring dumps, not prose.
